inShort: A dinks short to the middle, then pulls B wide. B resets into the kitchen, and you go straight into the next round. 5 in a row.
rules: A and B stand diagonally at the kitchen line, cross-court.
A dinks short to the middle, then pulls the next ball out wide.
B gets to the ball, turns toward it, paddle low, and resets it soft into the kitchen.
Both go straight back to the middle and into the next round, no break.
Go for 5 rounds in a row. A miss starts the count again.
tooEasy: Play at normal rally tempo, and A varies how wide and how fast the pull comes.
tooHard: A shows each pull clearly and plays slowly; B thinks only about the feet between balls.
goodLooksLike: B's feet have stopped when B hits the wide ball, and the reset lands low in the kitchen, so A has to dink it back instead of attacking.
